from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
    cnt = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    fill = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    order = [c for c,_ in cnt.most_common()]
    line = order[1]
    keep = set(order[2:])
    mr = sorted({r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c] in keep for c in range(W))})
    mc = sorted({c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c] in keep for r in range(H))})
    if not mr or not mc: return [[fill]]
    # full line-color rows/cols strictly between first and last marker line
    rows = list(mr) + [r for r in range(mr[0]+1, mr[-1]) if all(g[r][c]==line for c in range(W))]
    cols = list(mc) + [c for c in range(mc[0]+1, mc[-1]) if all(g[r][c]==line for r in range(H))]
    rows, cols = sorted(set(rows)), sorted(set(cols))
    out = [[fill]*(len(cols)-1) for _ in range(len(rows)-1)]
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            cs = [g[rows[i]][cols[j]], g[rows[i]][cols[j+1]], g[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], g[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            if len(set(cs))==1 and cs[0] in keep:

    return out
